import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, os.getcwd())
from parallel_linear import ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear
def run(rank, ws, port):
    os.environ["MASTER_ADDR"]="127.0.0.1"; os.environ["MASTER_PORT"]=str(port)
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    W=torch.randn(8,12); x=torch.randn(3,12)
    for cls in (ColumnParallelLinear, RowParallelLinear):
        ref=torch.nn.Linear(12,8); ref.weight.data.copy_(W); ref.bias.data.zero_()
        m=cls(12,8,True,W.clone())
        xr=x.clone().requires_grad_(); xm=x.clone().requires_grad_()
        yr=ref(xr); ym=m(xm)
        assert torch.allclose(yr,ym,atol=1e-5), cls
        yr.pow(2).sum().backward(); ym.pow(2).sum().backward()
        if cls is ColumnParallelLinear:
            n=8//ws; gw=ref.weight.grad[rank*n:(rank+1)*n]; gb=ref.bias.grad[rank*n:(rank+1)*n]
        else:
            n=12//ws; gw=ref.weight.grad[:,rank*n:(rank+1)*n]; gb=ref.bias.grad
        assert torch.allclose(m.weight.grad,gw,atol=1e-4), (cls,"w")
        assert torch.allclose(m.bias.grad,gb,atol=1e-4), (cls,"b")
        assert torch.allclose(xm.grad,xr.grad,atol=1e-4), (cls,"x")
    dist.destroy_process_group()
if __name__=="__main__":
    for i,ws in enumerate((1,2,4)):
        mp.spawn(run,args=(ws,29600+i),nprocs=ws); print("ok",ws)
